- E249 (2026-10-28): position-stocks: a rank-1 stock that fails a per-symbol sizing / level check no longer ends the whole cycle, and the day-mover scan no longer lists moves entry always refuses. Read from `latest_results_rt/ps.zip` + the screenshots (Groww MTF list, 12:15 IST). **Bug 1:** `orders/entry.py::_SYMBOL_SPECIFIC_SKIP_PREFIXES` lacked `MIN_QTY`, `RR_FLOOR`, `STOP_ATR_FLOOR`, `MIN_PRICE`, so `main.py` treated them as global and broke out of the shortlist loop, and `_GATE_COOLDOWN_PREFIXES` lacked them too, so the same name came back as rank 1 every ~15 s. `_unaffordable_filter` only compares ONE share with the pool's free cash, not with slot / `ENTRY_MIN_QTY`, so any stock priced above roughly slot/3 (recorded slots are Rs 1,600-2,900 over 15 trades) reached the quality gate, hit `MIN_QTY` and blocked every cheaper passer behind it. Fix: the four prefixes fall through and start the existing 60 s cooldown (`GATE_REJECT_COOLDOWN_S`); global reasons (armed, kill switch, order budget, max positions, quality gate) still end the cycle. **Bug 2:** the scan listed day movers up to `DAY_MOVER_MAX_PCT` 20 % (short 20 %) while entry refuses a long above `MAX_DAY_GAIN_PCT` 7 % and a short below `SHORT_MAX_DAY_FALL_PCT` 5 %, so +15 % names used quality-gate slots to be refused later. New `engine._day_mover_max(side)` = min of the two (guard 0 = off); `/scan/why/{symbol}` now says "beyond the entry guard" instead of "qualifies as a day mover". What can be bought is unchanged (same previous close feeds both checks). Tests: new tests/test_e249_fallthrough_and_daymover_cap.py (8), tests/test_e232 short day-mover test moved from a 6 % to a 4.5 % faller; position-stocks full suite 4492 passed. Not run: live feed, real-trade suite (no change there). Not changed: real-trade candidate funnel, SELL probe verdict (re-run the probe after deploying E244/E246).
- E248 (2026-10-28): why nothing is bought or sold from 09:15, why so few opening orders go out, and a read-only study of the opening move on your own bars. **No trading rule changed.** Reading the code (position-stocks, no live logs in the zip): (1) the entry window itself opens at 09:15 (`ENTRY_NO_BEFORE_IST`, `OPENING_GATE_MIN_MINUTES_AFTER_OPEN` 0), so the clock is not the blocker. (2) The scan cannot list a normal candidate before about 09:20: `_rolling_pct_change` needs a tick at least one window old, the 1 and 15 minute windows are off (`DISABLED_SCAN_WINDOWS` 1,15), so the first rolling candidate needs the 5-minute window (+1.0 %) and five minutes of ticks. The only 09:15 path is the day-mover (`DAY_MOVER_MIN_PCT` 4 %), and a stock already 4 % up at the open is a gap that the opening gate (`OPENING_GATE_MAX_GAP_UP_PCT` 3 %) and the pre-open gap block (`PREOPEN_GAP_UP_BLOCK_PCT` 6 %, 1.5 x ATR) refuse until 10:00, so the two rules cancel each other at the bell. (3) After that every automatic entry in 09:15-10:00 must pass, in order: pre-open gap, opening gate (fails closed: previous day closed in the upper half, price at/above open and previous close, opening range built after 09:30, Nifty), quality gate, then sizing: half size until 09:45 (`OPENING_SIZE_MULT` 0.5) and `ENTRY_MIN_QTY` 3, so a stock whose price is more than a third of the half-size slot is skipped as MIN_QTY (on about Rs 18k capital this removes most mid and high priced names); two stop-outs pause entries until 09:45 and three pause the day. Caps: 5 open positions, 10 entries a day. (4) SELL: automatic shorts start at 09:45 by design (`SHORT_ENTRY_START_IST`, the day VWAP is thin before that) and `SHORT_MAX_POSITIONS` is 2; exits of held longs are not time-gated. (5) The 09:10 pre-open snapshot (`screening/preopen.py`) is used only as a BLOCKER for big gaps, never to choose or rank a buy or sell; a real NSE pre-open order book (indicative equilibrium price, buy/sell quantities) is still not read by any service. NSE facts used (NSE and broker pages): order entry 09:00-09:08, matching 09:08-09:12, buffer 09:12-09:15, the equilibrium price is the day open. Research on opening-range breakouts with high-volume stocks (Zarattini, Barbon, Aziz) is on US stocks 2016-2023, not NSE, so it is a reason to measure, not proof. This repo's own 14-day breakdown (group 268: entries before 10:30 won 1 of 10) and the September REAL split (09-10 h entries lost most) point the other way, which is why the gates were not loosened without a measurement. **New `scripts/preopen_momentum_study.py`** (read-only, stdlib, `python3 scripts/preopen_momentum_study.py BAR_DIR [--days 20] [--out DIR] [--candidate-log cand.json]`): on the recorded 1-minute bars it measures, per gap bucket and exit time (09:45, 10:00, 10:30, 15:00), A_follow (buy/sell at the 09:15 open in the direction of the pre-open gap), A_fade (the opposite), B_5m (side of the first five minutes, entry 09:20), C_agree (gap and first five minutes agree) and ORB5 (opening-range breakout, stop at the other end of the range), net of `--cost-pct` (0.15), with a 95 % interval built on daily means and a verdict that needs `--min-n` 30 and `--min-days` 10. With `--candidate-log` (from `/candidates/log?limit=500`) it also counts the 09:15-10:00 candidate rows by skipping gate and entries by half hour. Tests: scripts/test_preopen_momentum_study.py 11 passed (stand-in runner, pytest not installed here); one measured number checked against an independent calculation on random-walk bars. Not run: any service suite (no service code changed), real bars (none in the zip). Next step: copy the `bar-records` volume out, run the study over the latest 20 dates, and paste the A_follow vs B_5m tables; only a bucket with verdict `edge` over enough days gets a small switchable live change.

The probe then adopted the short as a normal row (`window_source PROBE`, status EXIT_LEGS_REJECTED, Cover -), while Dhan's positions already showed ONGC closed (sold 223.83, bought 223.85, net 0). The probe had cancelled that row's own Super Order legs, so the leg-based reconcile could never see an exit, and a later Exit Now or the 14:55 cover would have BUY-ed a share that is not short, opening a real LONG. **Fix (`orders/sell_probe.py`):** the cover wait now also reads Dhan's POSITIONS (every 2nd second and at the end); flat beyond the baseline with a cover placed counts as covered (price = position buyAvg, else the reference), and a last positions look runs before any row is adopted. An adopted row keeps the cover order id in `dhan_exit_order_id`. **Heal (`orders/reconcile.py`, new `heal_covered_probe_shorts`, first step of `run_exit_reconciliation`, 15 s throttle):** a PROBE SHORT row that is OPEN or EXIT_LEGS_REJECTED is closed (status MANUAL_EXIT) when Dhan's positions are readable, hold a row for the security and show nothing open on it; exit price = the cover order's own fill (by `dhan_exit_order_id`, else a traded SELLPROBE_COVER BUY), else the position's buyAvg; P&L uses the short sign (ONGC: -0.02). Unreadable positions, no row, an open delivery row, no readable price, or any non-probe short: row left alone. A probe never reserved ledger capital, so none is released. The existing ONGC row heals on the first reconcile after deploy (or press Check Exits Now). **Guard (`orders/eod_squareoff.py::_fire_flat_sell`):** a PROBE short is healed first and, if it was already covered, `PositionAlreadyFlat` is raised so no cover BUY is sent. **CI:** `tests/test_short_foundation.py` failed because `main.py` read `SHORT_MODE` for the SELL orders route; it now uses `short_entry.cfg_mode()` (same off/shadow/live value), so only the allowed modules read it. `frontend/src/appHelpers.test.mjs` failed on `TabButton.tsx deleted`: `components/app/TabButton.tsx` and `BackendStatusDot.tsx` (E70 removed them, nothing imports them) were back in the tree; deleted again. - E137 (2026-10-25): swing lane: a stock with a stale last bar is never picked. Bug (reading `swing/engine.py` and `ranker.py`):** the snapshot's bar date is the newest bar of ANY stock. A stock that is halted, suspended or has stale data keeps its old last bar (days old) but still gets a rank, a `screen` flag and an ATR. It could be PLANNED as a pick. In shadow it was then SKIPPED at settle ("no bar for the entry session"), wasting one of the day's pick slots; in `live` the morning entry reads the PLANNED rows and would try to buy it on the strength of old prices.

No way out except editing the database. Now `probe.waiting_for_check(prev)` is true only for an open phase that placed a stop (has `stop_id`) ...

- 2026-10-04 (group 81)  Log-audit item 1: the 20 s `/decide` timeout (and no overall deadline) in `api-gateway/main.py::
  get_stock_decision` (`GET /stock/{symbol}`). The first analysis after a boot (cold caches, competing with the start-up
  warm-ups and the hot-picks scan) overran the hard 20 s read timeout, the gateway returned a neutral HOLD, and the decision
  service's finished work was thrown away. Now: (1) decide read timeout `STOCK_DECIDE_TIMEOUT_SEC` (default 60 s);
  (2) one retry on `ReadTimeout` only, WITHOUT `force` (so it can use the downstream caches the first attempt warmed, or a
  decision that finished meanwhile), only if >= `STOCK_DECIDE_RETRY_MIN_SEC` (15 s) of the deadline is left; (3) an overall
  deadline `STOCK_OVERALL_DEADLINE_SEC` (default 100 s, under the browser's 120 s timeout): every call's timeout is clamped
  to the time left, the enrichment fan-out uses `asyncio.wait` so finished calls are kept and slow ones cancelled (was
  `gather`, which could outlive the budget), and Gemini is skipped (template) with < 3 s left or cut off at the deadline;

- group422: record-only path for the decision structure policy (item 3 of the 16 Oct review; defaults unchanged, nothing loosens). Group 370 removed shadow mode, so a rule could only be live or the whole policy off. `STRUCTURE_POLICY_MODE=record` evaluates every rule and applies none; `STRUCTURE_POLICY_SHADOW_RULES=P7,P8` makes just those rules (id or `_`-boundary prefix) record-only while the rest stay live. Old `shadow` / `caps` values still mean live. The `structure` block gains `shadow_rules` + `would_be_decision`; a record-only rule that fired also blocks a P9 upgrade (an upgrade only runs in full mode) and record mode leaves legacy stop / target alone. Observation hook stores `shadow:<id>` rules + `features.would_be` so a report can compare would-be vs actual (`structure_obs` whitelists `would_be`). Frontend `policyRecord` / snapshot / tally show record-only rules as "shadow, not applied". Files: decision/structure_policy.py, structure_obs_hook.py, training/structure_obs.py, frontend structureView.ts(+test), docker-compose.yml, .env.example, ENV_REFERENCE.md, tests/test_group422_policy_record_mode.py. See docs/GROUP422_POLICY_RECORD_MODE.md.
- group423: independent-groups count that does not double-count (item 2 of the 16 Oct review; OFF by default, nothing changes live). The five TQS groups overlap: `location` re-reads zone / fib / support / room that `zones` already saw, and `risk` comes from the same stop / target as room, so P7's "2 groups" was often one piece of evidence counted twice. Engine (shared + 5 vendored copies, synced) adds `independent_groups_strict` (0..3 = structure, entry zone = max(zones, location), liquidity; risk dropped because P4 gates R:R itself) -> summary `ms_groups_strict`; the existing `independent_groups_positive` / `ms_groups` / TQS are unchanged. Policy rule `P7X_INDEP` (BUY NOW -> PREPARE) fires only when `groups_strict_min` > 0 (default 0; `STRUCTURE_POLICY_PARAMS_JSON={"groups_strict_min":2}`); a missing value trips it when on (unknown is never bullish). Run it record-only with `STRUCTURE_POLICY_SHADOW_RULES=P7X` (group422) and read `shadow:P7X_INDEP` / `features.groups_strict` from the observations; P7 does not cover P7X. Golden file regenerated (only the new key differs). Files: shared/market_structure/{scoring,engine,summary}.py (+vendored), decision/structure_policy.py, structure_obs_hook.py, training/structure_obs.py, frontend structureView.ts, tests. See docs/GROUP423_STRICT_INDEPENDENT_GROUPS.md.

Now flags `drop_one_edge_pp < -0.05` (n >= 30); test fixed and a regression test added in `scripts/test_structure_gate_check.py`. A failure now stamps `ms_failed_at` / `ms_fail_n` on the feed row (old structure keys kept; never creates a row), logs a WARNING naming the symbol, and backs the symbol off 1 h, 2 h, 4 h ... 24 h. A later answered attempt (newer `ms_refreshed_at`) or `force` lifts it; a REFRESHED or UNCHANGED result also drops the stamp (both keys are in `OWNED_KEYS`). 12 new tests in `tests/test_group360_structure_refresh.py` + one existing assertion updated. (3) real-trade `tests/test_group294_late_close_refresh.py` no longer depends on the clock: `now + 25 h` is the day after tomorrow in IST between 23:00 and 24:00, so it is pinned to 01:00 IST on the next IST day.
